description: Judge-free development comparison of one deterministic multi-proposal call against three independently seeded exploratory proposal calls followed by deterministic validator selection, with matched output-token and request-time ceilings.
claim_limits: All tasks and finite feasibility rules are repository-visible; this is not a hidden benchmark.
The experiment measures valid unique feasible proposals and objective selection recovery, not scientific novelty.
Five tasks and one run cannot authorize a production inference-policy change.

tasks.problem: In a two-player game with row and column actions [adopt,status_quo], row payoffs are [[4,0],[3,3]] and column payoffs are [[4,3],[0,3]]. Propose one pure Nash equilibrium.

provenance.derivation: Hand-authored two-action coordination game with two objectively enumerable pure equilibria.
provenance.claim_limit: Finite public development task; no empirical or novelty claim.

tasks.problem: Construct nonnegative integer counts for all six strict rankings ABC, ACB, BAC, BCA, CAB, CBA. Counts must sum to 7. A must be the unique plurality winner by first choices, while B must be the unique Condorcet winner under pairwise majority.

provenance.derivation: Finite integer-composition construction with six valid profiles under the declared rules.
provenance.claim_limit: Finite public development task; no empirical or novelty claim.

tasks.problem: Assign each voter x, y, z one value from [A,B,->x,->y,->z]. Direct A/B votes count for every origin whose transitive delegation reaches them. Cycles exhaust. Construct a graph resolving to totals A=2, B=1 with no exhausted voters.
tasks.proposal_contract: A proposal is exactly {"x":"allowed value","y":"allowed value","z":"allowed value"}.

provenance.derivation: Complete 5^3 delegation domain with nine valid target graphs.
provenance.claim_limit: Finite public development task; no empirical or novelty claim.

tasks.problem: Choose integer a,b,c,d from [0,1,2,3,4] for a symmetric two-action game. The row payoff matrix is [[a,b],[c,d]] and the column payoff matrix is its transpose. Both diagonal profiles must be strict Nash equilibria and the interior symmetric probability of the first action must equal 0.5.

provenance.derivation: Complete 5^4 payoff domain with strict-equilibrium and exact-indifference checks.
provenance.claim_limit: Finite public development task; no empirical or novelty claim.

tasks.problem: In the weighted voting game [6:4,3,2,1], players p,q,r,s have those weights and quota 6. Propose one minimal winning coalition: it reaches quota and removing any member makes it lose.
tasks.proposal_contract: A proposal is exactly {"coalition":[distinct player IDs]}; array order is irrelevant.

provenance.derivation: Complete subset enumeration yields three minimal winning coalitions.
provenance.claim_limit: Finite public development task; no empirical or novelty claim.
